scope.method: Read-only source/design comparison against exact native ZIP members; no candidate builder, generic validator, negative test, native replay or route replayer execution.
scope.mutable_build_warning: Builder and README changed during the review. Findings apply to the recorded snapshots only, not an unspecified later package or final pass.

overall.conclusion: The inspected design preserves the requested native identity, graph, state, course-partition and rights distinctions without claiming aggregate conformance. Two proof dependencies remain outside this source-only review; neither is a finding that the separately owned root tests failed.

evidenced_design_coverage.finding: All native units are emitted once. Projected UUIDv5 keys use corpus-qualified native IDs, not translated titles, selectors, URLs or live ordering. Explicit identity-crosswalk rows retain native aliases and birth/current selectors. Native IDs remain in payloads and exact row references.

Every relation is retained with type, native from/to IDs, scope, ordinal and provenance. Endpoint resolution searches native record namespaces, with a separate exact-row endpoint index; non-unit endpoints are not coerced to unit IDs. The 104 non-unit relations are not lost by unit-only filtering.

Only the 23 native chapter memberships become membership records. Per-unit course association and course-views are explicitly derived by native parent traversal, not presented as 3293 native membership rows. Both course views share one canonical unit graph.
The 30 support units outside both native chapter selectors remain canonical units with no inferred course role. They are not duplicated into or forced into C30/C40.

All 4466 native pairs retain both native record IDs, matching source hashes, raw target hashes, states, locale and reasons. Full text and protected XML/code are not copied. The 316 null target hashes stay null; disposition/path-derived preservation hashes have separately named fields and explicitly limited evidence bases.

Unit state is the direct attached-pair state set, with mixed and no-segment-evidence preserved. Native active/xml_lang metadata is not promoted to translation completion. Three authored Indonesian edition segments are separate evidence, not fabricated translation pairs.

The native modified GFDL-1.3-or-later and upstream GFDL-1.2-or-later remain distinct. English operative GFDL policy and complete native notices remain exact references. The code's two-edition license projection agrees with the inspected frozen native editions and rights rows; no central license replaces them.

Structure/localization metadata is materialized. Terminology, richer mathematical preservation, assessment, assets, corrections, computation, publication and research evidence remain referenced native shards. Accessibility is not_projected. Counts are identified as full referenced-shard row counts, not exercise or completeness counts. No runtime/Sage/Lean, mastery, learner consumption, full semantic translation review, native full replay or aggregate conformance is asserted.

The updated code requires one route for every native chapter and checks course, membership, sequence, source path and chapter ID against the frozen native rows. It treats 23 dated HTTP200 observations and 0 frozen-byte matches as separate facts, leaves current live edition identity unverified, and makes only chapter-page fallback claims, not descendant anchors. This is code-level coverage; the route witness bytes and route replay were outside this review's allowed reads.

The builder reads the exact public source ZIP, bundled frozen central contract/capsules, bundled pinned helpers/schemas and a bundled frozen supplemental route witness. It has no hard-coded private profile/control path or mutable owner fallback. README documents portable commands and distinguishes package-only checks from exact external-authority validation. The supplemental witness is honestly labelled candidate evidence, not falsely claimed as a prior public-release file.

proof_dependencies_not_verified_here.evidence: The builder assigns build_a_sha256 and build_b_sha256 from the same single-build payload_digest and writes deterministic_replay=byte_identical. The unchanged frozen lane schema requires these values; merely satisfying that schema does not prove two executions.
proof_dependencies_not_verified_here.consequence: Do not treat the manifest fields alone as G8 evidence. README correctly requires separate build-a/build-b and external generic validation, so this is not a finding that those separately owned executions failed.
proof_dependencies_not_verified_here.next_action: Bind the root admission handoff to the actual unchanged-validator two-build comparison receipt and both final package identities. Do not weaken the frozen schema or promote a one-build self-declaration into independent replay.

proof_dependencies_not_verified_here.evidence: The declared reverse_recipe resolves the original native row in the exact source ZIP and verifies its recorded row digest. The inspected builder contains no inverse extractor/test. Some native envelope fields, unit source_attrs and full prose are intentionally not copied, so candidate-only reconstruction of complete native rows is not demonstrated.
proof_dependencies_not_verified_here.consequence: The design provides sufficient native identity/member/ordinal/line-byte/hash locators for zero-copy inverse extraction using the public archive, but code inspection and a nonempty reverse_recipe do not establish G7 byte identity. No claim that full prose is reconstructed should be made.
proof_dependencies_not_verified_here.next_action: Root-owned semantic QA should identify the exact reversible metadata streams, execute the declared archive-backed reverse recipe, compare original row bytes/order and complete stream hashes, and demonstrate rejection of mutated metadata/mappings. Keep excluded prose and reference-only capabilities explicit.

observation_limits: No generated build directories, seals, generic validation reports, root semantic/negative reports or native-replay receipts were read or executed. Claims about their pass/fail status are outside this review.
The workflow's completed native-replay assertions were read as workflow claims, not independently revalidated here.

The supplemental route witness, route replayer implementation, public WEB.zip and public RELEASE_MANIFEST were not inspected here; only their use and pinned identities in the allowed builder/README were reviewed.
No network, browser/UI, owner/shared-source edits, production messages, task control, new agents, publication or Lean/Lake operation was performed.

The required route witness and copied dependencies must travel with any public candidate package. Portable source code does not prove that a future publisher actually included them; the final inventory/seal and publication readback belong to root/integrator gates.
Only INDEPENDENT_DESIGN_REVIEW.json was written by this review.
